prelude:
type Account = {id: Str, balance: Int}
type TxErr = Insufficient{short: Int} | Invalid
sig: fn withdraw(a: Account, amt: Int) -> Account ! fail[TxErr]
desc: Raise Invalid if amt <= 0. Raise Insufficient{short: amt - a.balance} if amt > a.balance. Otherwise return the account with the balance reduced.
tests:
catch withdraw({id: "a", balance: 10}, 0).balance == 0
  | Invalid => true
  | _ => false

catch withdraw({id: "a", balance: 10}, 15).balance == 0
  | Insufficient{short} => short == 5
  | _ => false

prelude:
type Account = {id: Str, balance: Int}
type TxErr = Insufficient{short: Int} | Invalid
sig: fn apply_all(a: Account, amts: List[Int]) -> Account ! fail[TxErr]
desc: Withdraw each amount in order (same rules: amt <= 0 raises Invalid, overdraft raises Insufficient{short}). Stop at the first error.
tests:
catch apply_all({id: "a", balance: 5}, [3, 3]).balance == 0
  | Insufficient{short} => short == 1
  | _ => false

prelude: type Tree = Leaf | Node{left: Tree, value: Int, right: Tree}
desc: True if an in-order traversal gives strictly increasing values.
tests: is_bst(Node{left: Node{left: Leaf, value: 1, right: Leaf}, value: 2, right: Node{left: Leaf, value: 3, right: Leaf}})
not is_bst(Node{left: Node{left: Leaf, value: 5, right: Leaf}, value: 2, right: Leaf})
not is_bst(Node{left: Node{left: Leaf, value: 2, right: Leaf}, value: 2, right: Leaf})
